local_override.forbidden_when: broker enabled; original home+broker gate remains required
local_override.consumer_override: component J13/J14 may use home-only gate only while broker disabled; full legacy wrapper remains unsatisfied until broker recovery

resource_queues.rule: one candidate at a time; rebase, allocate number, verify lineage and rerun on latest main

future_preflight: Open unknown blocks only declared stage; every scoped gate needs exact candidate evidence and retained gates for enabled scope; no planned row is evidence
case_evidence_rule: each referenced case must pass on exact candidate/support cell; original not_run is not evidence; deferred cases block corresponding scope activation and full legacy completion
merge_after_semantics: conditional ordering when both PRs exist; no feature prerequisite if predecessor canceled; current-base shared-path review still required
migration_evidence_rule: each queued PR freezes its actual N->N+1 and exact DDL/fixture/candidate after rebase; prior recovery certificate never qualifies another tuple
joint_case_evidence_rule: joint_case_requirements names joint acceptance cases, separately from legacy case_requirements. Each required case needs independently frozen oracle and passing exact-candidate/support-cell evidence; planned rows and component structure checks grant no runtime authority. All rows here remain specified_not_run.
